fusions.name: Scale Splitter
fusions.desc: Throws your whole body into a rolling slam that deals 15 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks each back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tucked Roll
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Seams Vanish
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Curled Against Danger
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you gain a ward that absorbs 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
